name: send_webhook
description: Send webhook to trigger n8n workflows or external services. Supports named webhooks from config/webhook_registry.json (e.g., 'notify_slack', 'home_assistant') OR direct URLs. Rate limited to prevent duplicates. Use 'list' to see available webhooks.

webhook.description: Named webhook from registry (e.g., 'notify_slack', 'home_assistant'). Use 'list' to see available webhooks.

url.description: Direct webhook URL (alternative to named webhook)

data.description: JSON data to send in the webhook body

headers.description: Optional literal HTTP headers to include in the request. Environment placeholders such as ${API_KEY} are rejected; configure credential headers in config/webhook_registry.json.
